Practised identifying a point, line segment, line and ray by endpoints and arrows.
Aryan correctly described line segments as having two endpoints and lines as extending in both directions.
They used a torch beam to explain a ray, with one endpoint and no stopping point.

Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised identifying these figures using endpoints, arrows and direction. Aryan explained the torch-beam example for a ray and stated the difference between a line segment and a line. They mixed up the length of a drawing with the type of line, so at home ask them to compare two differently sized drawings and check whether their endpoints and arrows are the same.
